answer: Senior-rights payouts, borrowed from western water law: each epoch's pool is a river, and every passing answer claims a fixed 10-token allotment, filled in order of the ID's priority date. When demand outruns flow, juniors are cut first. A farm minting 5,000 clones makes its own drought: if 900 elders already claim 9,000 of 10,000 tokens, the clones split 1,000, 0.2 each. Rights lapse after 12 missed epochs, so sable-dark sleeper IDs can't bank seniority; priority is dug like umber from a riverbank, only by working it. Proposed numbers.
